# Notice

This is an independent CDN packaging project derived from the public font
collection curated by **SaturnGod (Htain Lin Shwe)** at
<https://github.com/saturngod/myanmar-unicode-fonts>.

The original repository contains fonts from multiple creators and collections,
including files whose authorship or licensing is not documented. No
repository-wide license was found in the upstream source at the time this
package was created.

Accordingly:

1. SaturnGod and the upstream contributors are credited for the collection and
   source application.
2. Known font studios and collections are credited in `CREDITS.md` and in the
   generated catalog.
3. All fonts default to an **unverified** license status.
4. This project makes no claim of ownership over the font files and grants no
   rights beyond rights provided by their respective copyright holders.
5. Public CDN operators are responsible for confirming redistribution,
   embedding, modification, and commercial-use rights.

Dependency-license metadata in an npm lockfile is not evidence of a font's
license.

Additional non-overlapping fonts are sourced from
<https://github.com/AungMyoKyaw/Myanmar-Unicode-Fonts>. That repository is the
recorded source and license-information URL for those imports, but linking to a
repository does not create or replace a license. These entries remain marked
`unverified`. Some imported files contain vendor names or identify themselves
as Zawgyi; the generated catalog flags those cases for downstream operators.

`khzaw/awesome-myanmar-unicode` is a discovery index rather than a font binary
archive. Masterpiece Uni Sans is fetched from its canonical Prahita SourceForge
release and recorded as OFL-licensed based on Prahita's release announcement.
